key_idea: To bound crossing probabilities and control elapsed time, the proof compares shared and independent environments across multiple scales, finally using entropy bounds on a stationary law of endpoint profiles to derive a contradiction.
reason: The argument relies on a massive chain of over 38 lemmas, heavy multiscale analysis, and dense bookkeeping. While the shift to stationary profiles and entropy provides a clever conceptual skeleton, the core ideas remain deeply buried under intricate technical estimates.
